title: Browser approval gates
summary: A recipe step typed operator_gate machine_browser_approval approves the installer's one-time code in the test machine's own signed-in browser: Safari on macOS, the desktop Chromium on Linux and WSL. Every driver shares one matcher: only the installer-opened tab on the declared origin with the displayed code, revalidated before Approve machine is pressed, and only a same-origin navigation away from it counts. On Linux the gate starts the desktop and Chromium with a loopback DevTools port and runs the installer on that desktop; the step always attaches a desktop screenshot. A host without a desktop refuses headless_linux_browser_approval_unavailable with the provisioning recovery.
